headline: Anthropic's IPO filing exposes massive burn rate and regulatory scrutiny
body: Anthropic has filed for IPO while revealing $1.7 billion in quarterly payroll and $900 billion in AI infrastructure commitments, prompting regulatory questions about sustainable economics. The filing also warns the company may be imminently close to running out of cash. For healthcare AI vendors and health systems evaluating Anthropic-based solutions, this financial disclosure raises questions about long-term platform stability and vendor viability in critical clinical applications. Healthcare organizations must factor financial sustainability into AI vendor due diligence, particularly for solutions integrated into EHR workflows or supporting value-based care operations where continuity is non-negotiable.
